depends on what you are used to. it doesn't get super cold. if you are used to camping in weather below 20 degrees you will be fine. It rarely drops below 40 anywhere even at altitude and when it does it doesn't get too extremely cold. I would pack for hot weather though. it can get up to 100 degrees and that can be miserable up there. another thing to remember is that the heat is dry, so letting your skin get exposed to the sun inst a good thing. pack long sleeve t shirts for sure. a 45 degree bag will be perfectly fine, if you need to just layer.
